content.title: Clean up stale docs-html directory and verify dual-format output
content.description:
The old packages/library/docs-html/ directory was not cleaned up during the docs migration (issue mpctz79p1k). The library-release agent couldn't delete it due to sandbox permissions.

Tasks:
1. Delete packages/library/docs-html/ (stale directory from before the migration)
2. Run 'bun run docs' from packages/library/ to regenerate both formats
3. Verify docs/html/ and docs/md/ exist at repo root with correct content
4. Confirm packages/library/docs-html/ no longer exists

Context: The npm scripts are already correctly configured:
- docs:html → typedoc --out ../../docs/html
- docs:md → typedoc --plugin typedoc-plugin-markdown --out ../../docs/md --hideBreadcrumbs --hidePageHeader
- docs → runs both in sequence

The .gitignore already has docs/ to ignore generated output.

content.content: This is a cleanup from the incomplete migration in mpctzf23nq. Your own comment noted that the old directory needed deletion but sandbox permissions blocked it. The validation in mpctzodobf also flagged this as AC9 FAIL. The scripts and config are all correct — just need the stale directory removed and a fresh generation verified.

Done. All 4 acceptance criteria verified:

1. Deleted packages/library/docs-html/ (stale directory from before migration) — confirmed removed.
2. Ran 'bun run docs' from packages/library/ — both formats regenerated successfully.
3. Verified docs/html/ (9 entries: index.html, hierarchy.html, assets/, classes/, interfaces/, types/) and docs/md/ (4 entries: README.md, classes/, interfaces/, type-aliases/) exist at repo root with correct content.
4. Confirmed packages/library/docs-html/ no longer exists.

No caveats — clean regeneration, all output paths match the configured typedoc scripts.
